- Free Resources: My collection of free resources
  - filo_bolt
    - [filo_bolt](/docs/free_resources/filo_bolt): A 3D lug nut minigame for FiveM vehicle wheel interactions.
    - [Installation](/docs/free_resources/filo_bolt/installation): How to add filo_bolt to your FiveM server.
    - [Configuration](/docs/free_resources/filo_bolt/configuration): Config options available in config.lua.
    - [Export](/docs/free_resources/filo_bolt/export): Full reference for the Start export.
    - [Examples](/docs/free_resources/filo_bolt/examples): Common usage patterns for filo_bolt.
  - filo_jack
    - [filo_jack](/docs/free_resources/filo_jack)
    - [Installation](/docs/free_resources/filo_jack/installation)
    - [Configuration](/docs/free_resources/filo_jack/configuration)
    - [Exports](/docs/free_resources/filo_jack/exports)
    - [Usage](/docs/free_resources/filo_jack/usage)
  - filo_slashtire
    - [filo_slashtire](/docs/free_resources/filo_slashtire)
  - filo_stealwheels
    - [filo_stealwheels](/docs/free_resources/filo_stealwheels): Realistic wheel removal system for FiveM.
    - [Installation](/docs/free_resources/filo_stealwheels/installation)
    - [Configuration](/docs/free_resources/filo_stealwheels/configuration)
    - [Usage](/docs/free_resources/filo_stealwheels/usage)
    - [FAQ](/docs/free_resources/filo_stealwheels/faq)
  - filo_textui
    - [filo_textui](/docs/free_resources/filo_textui): Lightweight world-space and screen-space text UI for FiveM.

    - **3D Labels**
    - [DrawText3D](/docs/free_resources/filo_textui/draw-text-3d): Render a label stack in world space, attached to an entity or fixed coordinates.
    - [HideText3D](/docs/free_resources/filo_textui/hide-text-3d): Destroy an active 3D world label.
    - [IsTextVisible](/docs/free_resources/filo_textui/is-text-visible): Check whether a 3D label is currently active.

    - **2D Text UI**
    - [DrawText](/docs/free_resources/filo_textui/draw-text): Show the 2D bottom bar prompt, or attach a single label to an entity.
    - [HideText](/docs/free_resources/filo_textui/hide-text): Hide the 2D bottom bar prompt.
- Paid Resources: My collection of paid resources
  - 🔑 filo_vehiclekeys
    - [🔑 filo_vehiclekeys](/docs/paid_resources/filo_vehiclekeys): Item-based vehicle keys, theft, police and locksmith system for FiveM.
    - [Installation](/docs/paid_resources/filo_vehiclekeys/installation): Dependencies, items, controls and commands.
    - [Compatibility](/docs/paid_resources/filo_vehiclekeys/compatibility): qb-vehiclekeys, qbx_vehiclekeys, tr_minigames and the open bridge.
    - [Configuration](/docs/paid_resources/filo_vehiclekeys/configuration): Every config section in shared/sh-config.lua explained.
    - [Exports](/docs/paid_resources/filo_vehiclekeys/exports): Client and server exports provided by filo_vehiclekeys for use in other resources.
    - [Flows](/docs/paid_resources/filo_vehiclekeys/flows): Theft, carjacking, police, locksmith, admin panel and how keys are validated.
    - [Changelog](/docs/paid_resources/filo_vehiclekeys/changelog): What changed in v2.0.0 and how to update from v1.
